item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 09:15 AM 08 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Monreal, SanJacinto, Claveria), #CamarinesSur(IrigaCity, Buhi, Baao, Siruma, Minalabac, Bula) and #Albay(Polangui) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Catanduanes, #Sorsogon, #CamarinesSur(Lagonoy, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Presentacion, SanJose, Tigaon, Sagñay, Ocampo, Tinambac, Goa, NagaCity, Pili, Milaor, Canaman, Camaligan, Gainza, Bombon, Magarao, Calabanga), #Albay(Tiwi, Malinao, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Bacacay, SantoDomingo, LegazpiCity, Manito, Oas, CityOfLigao, Guinobatan, Camalig, Daraga, Jovellar and PioDuran) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
